investment_strategy: Quality-first AI barbell: overweight resilient, lower-volatility software/platform compounding (Microsoft) complemented by a momentum-driven search/ads + cloud AI beneficiary (Alphabet) and a smaller, high-octane allocation to the AI semiconductor leader (NVIDIA). Macro context (VIX ~17, 10Y ~3.8%) is neutral-to-supportive for growth/tech multiples; we size risk to favor stability while retaining upside to ongoing AI capex and adoption trends. We monitor regulatory actions (antitrust, AI safety) and U.S.-China export controls; position sizing reflects these tail risks.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: AI compounders with a quality tilt: overweight durable software/platform cash flows and maintain selective exposure to AI hardware momentum.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility with strong fundamental growth and positive analyst consensus; added momentum exposure where supported by earnings beats and trend. Position sizes reflect beta/volatility, trend signals, regulatory/export-control risks, and a macro backdrop of low-to-moderate VIX and stable 10Y yields.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive but selective for AI/tech: secular AI demand supports platforms and semis; expect intermittent volatility from capex cycles, antitrust actions, and U.S.-China tech decoupling. Stable rates and contained volatility support valuations, favoring quality growth leaders.
